name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime
description: Dev-time type + minimal-runtime stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed client surface (ClientContext, the ctx.slots service merge + settings/models invalidation events, SnapshotStore / createSnapshotStore with a minimal observable store, ObservableSnapshot). Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
